I'm Anne Angelo Webb, The Animal Intuitive — 20+ years supporting your animal family's behavioral, emotional & physical wellness through animal communication, acupressure & massage.

Learn with me on YouTube, or visit IntuitiveTouchAnimalCare.com for classes at Animal Intuitive® Academy, consultations & Wellness Plans with acupoints chosen for your pet at home — plus a free Animal Communication Meditation!

I'm a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), but this channel is educational/entertainment only—not therapy or clinical care, no therapist-client relationship formed here.

I also offer hypnosis & Brainspotting for communicators & others seeking peak performance.

📖 Children's author: Meesha's Heart Adventure: Emotional Regulation While Learning How Animals Think & Feel, & Meesha's Songs!

 🎤 Media inquiries: Anne@IntuitiveTouchAnimalCare.com

🎧 Also on Apple & Spotify Podcasts—search "Anne Angelo Webb The Animal Intuitive."

Subscribe & join our community!

God Bless, Anne
